title.zh: 芯片为什么越来越难做
title.en: Why Chips Are Getting Harder to Make

desc.zh: 从硅里的电子讲到 2nm、高数值孔径 EUV 和背面供电：十个可以拖动的模型，看清晶体管密度、每瓦性能、每颗良品的成本和光刻分辨率分别被什么卡住。
desc.en: From electrons in silicon to 2 nm, high-NA EUV and backside power: ten draggable models that show what holds back transistor density, performance per watt, cost per good die and lithographic resolution.
